key_concepts: Earth's atmosphere is composed of gases that make life possible.
Increasing carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is a concern that can be lessened by human act
The atmosphere is divided into layers: troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere, thermosphere
Each atmospheric layer has distinct features and temperature characteristics.
Temperature changes with altitude differ in each atmospheric layer.
Land heats up faster than water and cools off faster than water.
Warm air rises and surrounding air moves in to replace it.
Sea breeze occurs during daytime when air moves from sea to land.
Land breeze occurs at nighttime when air moves from land to sea.
Monsoons include Amihan and Habagat, driven by pressure and temperature differences.
The three-cell model describes air circulation in each hemisphere.
